title: RotRegister
description: The rot register (07 rule 2, Q60): the assumption each component was built on, reviewed when a trigger fires. This schema checks each entry's shape; that every module is covered, every component exists and no component repeats are checked by the register's test.

component.description: Repository-relative path of a file, or of a directory that covers every module below it.

ring.description: The component's ring in the 05 Rings table: 0 owner only, 1 evolve agent through the gate, 2 harness code.

assumption.description: The assumption the component was built on, as one line.

evidence.description: Where the assumption comes from or is tested: a design section ("07 rule 2"), a decision row ("decisions Q60"), a test path or a corpus entry.

reviewTrigger.description: What makes the assumption due for review: a model change, an engine change or a milestone end.
